review.scope: All 419 manual conditional reference rules and all published native conditional rules were inventoried. This import adds only confirmed non-reference ranges; unsupported branches remain unknown.
review.method: AI semantic review of the hash-matching original manuals, including adjacent pages; independent agent review of Volumes I and III. This is not native-consumer or solver certification.
review.retained: Original checkpoints, evidence identities, reference branches, targets and read/write permissions are unchanged.
